title: 2017 AMC 8 Problem 7
statement: Let \(Z\) be a \(6\)-digit positive integer, such as \(247247,\) whose first three digits are the same as its last three digits taken in the same order. Which of the following numbers must be a factor of \(Z?\)

solutions.text:
Let \(n\) be the three-digit number formed by either repeated block. Then \[\begin{aligned} Z&=1000n+n\\ &=1001n\\ &=7\cdot11\cdot13\cdot n. \end{aligned}\] Therefore, \(11\) must be a factor of \(Z.\)

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Let \(n\) be the three-digit block that is repeated. Express \(Z\) in terms of \(n\).
